title: Speaking and Reading
standfirst: Two tests on the same day — five questions answered aloud, then a reading paper.

sections.title: Speaking
format: Five questions, prepared in class, answered from memory.
questions: Tu habites où ? Dans quel pays ?

items: Answer in a full sentence, not a word.
Say it with the right sounds: i = “ee”, ou = “oo”, silent h, silent last letter.

sections.title: Reading
format: Fill the gaps with the missing words.
Read a short text and tick the sentences that are true.
Answer questions in English about short French texts.
A couple of tasks on language that has not been taught — use cognates, context and punctuation.
A short quiz on French culture and facts.
sections.advice: The teacher's advice: practise recognising the language taught. And remember la bise.
